Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses i) Mode of Tendering/Procurement:- Custom Bid & Limited Tender. Note:- This Tender is meant for the approved Two (02) Standardized vendors only approved by NALCO agai nst this particular tender. Therefore, the contract shall be awarded to the approved Limited bidders or their authorized dealers only. The offers of other bidders shall not be considered for evaluation against the tender and shall be rejected. ii) Scope of Supplier:- Supply Portion only. iii) Payment Term :- As per GeM GTC. However, the Payment of GST is subject to Reflection of the Party's Invoice in GSTR-2A/Annex-2 (GST new return) of NALCO. iv) Delivery Period :- Within 120 days (inclusive of time required for submission of samples and subsequen t approval) v) Demo Sample:- After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get the s ample/demo unit app roved from NALCO before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. a) The successful Bidder shall submit _1 No. sample against each item for Buyer's approval, within 20 days of award of contract. b) NALCO shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provid e complete list of modification required in the sample within 10 days of receipt of sample/demo unit. c) The supplier is required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated b y Buyer. d) If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be re-fixed wi thout LD for the period of delay in sample approval. e) In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may termina te the contract after notifying the deviations to the supplier. f) The Supplier shall carry out any modification required in the demo unit within 15 d ays from the date of I ntimation from NALCO. g) However delivery period which is inclusive of time required for submission of samples and subsequent a

pproval shall remain 120 days from the date of the PO. h) Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample , any expenses incur red by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the even t of such sample being found unacceptable by the NALCO. i) Only the accepted sample/demo unit shall form a part of the bulk supply i.e. the sample/demo unit shall be adjusted from the PO quantity. j) The payment shall be released to the supplier in case only when the sample/demo unit is accepted by N ALCO & the sample/demo unit supplied shall be adjusted from the PO quantity i.e. bulk supply shall be ma de by subtracting the sample/demo unit & in no case the payment shall be made against the rejected sam ples/demo units to the Supplier & the demo unit/sample shall be returned to the Supplier in case rejected. vi) Training:- The bidder shall provide 02 days of onsite training at the CPP site f or NALCO personnel on co nfiguration, calibration, diagnosis, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and all other functions of the s mart positioner. vii) LD:- Delivery period is the essence of the contract and the materials should be dispatched within this ti me, failing which, NALCO without prejudice to its rights under the contract shall have the option either to r ecover liquidated damage s @ 1/2% of order value per week or part thereof subject to a maximum of 5% o f the undelivered portion/ the order value (if the item(s) cannot be used unless full supply is made). Liquidated damages will be calculated on the basis of contract/ supply order price of services/ materials ex cluding duties and taxes, where such duties/ taxes have been shown separately in contract/ supply order. LD shall be recovered alo ng with applicable GST thereon. viii) RESTRICTION UNDER RULE 144(XI) OF GFR, 2017:- The vendors are request ed to go through the Rule 14 4(xi) of GFR 2017 and order No: 6/18/2019-PPD, dt d: 23/07/20 20 & 24/07/2020 and confirm to have co mplied the same. ix) LOCAL CONTENT OF PRODUCT:- The bidders are requested to go through the GoI Order No: P-45021/2/2 017-PP (BE-II), DTD: 16.09.2020 or amended thereafter for the purpose of Purchase Preference on the basi s of Local Content and submit the declaration accordingly. x) The bidders are requested to furnish the declaration towards implementation of the Integrity as per the format attached along with the NIT. xi) Contact Details:- The contact details is as follows:- a) Purchase Executive:- Mr. Hrudananda Sahoo Email: hrudananda.sahoo@nalcoindia.co.in Mobile:- 9437585716 b) Stores Executive (i.e. consignee):- Mr. Siba Behera Contact No-9437350693 Email: sibaprasad.behera@nalcoindia.co.in c) Technical Executive:- Mr. SANDEEP KUMAR Contact No-9437576496 Delivery Text
